About me

Construction coordination, lead generation and organised operations.

Reliable remote support across the business-development, procurement and day-to-day coordination needs of residential construction teams.

I support residential builders with prospect research, COA and professional-referral outreach, CRM follow-ups, consultant and trade coordination, quotation requests, tender lists, project trackers and document management. I also bring hands-on support in social media, short-form video, SEO-informed project content and online profiles. My public-sector administrative background adds careful scheduling, written correspondence and recordkeeping.

How I can help

Business development and project support, in one workflow.

From finding opportunities and sourcing consultants to managing bid requests, project records and content, I help busy construction teams stay organised.

Lead Generation & CRM

Research homeowners and professional referral partners, manage outreach lists, update HubSpot and track approved email follow-ups.

Consultant & Contractor Coordination

Identify relevant engineers, consultants, trades and suppliers; coordinate introductions, onboarding details, quotations and outstanding deliverables.

RFQs, Tendering & Pricing

Prepare and organise quote requests, distribute approved drawing packages, maintain bidder/tender lists and compare incoming pricing for team review.

Project Administration

Maintain project trackers, drawing and document registers, inbox follow-ups, calendars, meeting invitations and action items.

Social Media & Short-form Video

Develop captions and content schedules; edit project footage and testimonials for Reels, Shorts and other business channels.

SEO & Digital Profiles

Write SEO-informed project descriptions and support website content, Google Business Profile, Pinterest and construction-gallery updates.
